annotations.title: Prepare moving money between your accounts

description: Move money between YOUR accounts, in any direction: perps (trading wallet on Hyperliquid), predictions (your Polymarket deposit wallet) and earn_usdc (your trading wallet's USDC on Base). No fee of ours (Circle/Polymarket bridge fees shown in the summary). Moves from perps or earn_usdc return an operation for submit_operation (from earn_usdc: owner-signed Base transactions → pass owner_public_key); moves from predictions return a predictions batch: sign it with your AGENT wallet and call submit_predictions_batch.

all.description: true = move everything that can be moved

from.description: Account the money leaves: perps (trading wallet), predictions (deposit wallet) or earn_usdc (trading wallet on Base)

to.description: Account the money goes to (different from `from`)

name: move_funds
